newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Lite-on issuing US$45 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Lite-on issuing US$45 mln debt.

text.p: Lite-on Technology Corp, one of Taiwan's leading computer monitor manufacturers, said on Friday it would issue US$45 million in floating-rate notes in Europe to finance bank loan repayments.

"We will issue the US$45 million FRNs in late November or early December in Luxembourg to raise funds to repay our short-term bank loans to improve our financial infrastructure," Sam Huang, the firm's finance manager, told Reuters.
The five-year floating-rate notes will bear an all-in-cost rate of LIBOR plus 82 basis points, he said.
